title.narrative: ULGE uniting Local Government in Ethiopia

description.narrative: This direct grant to Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) will support the institutional and operational capacity of local governments, contributing to deepen Ethiopia's decentralization process. Local government representative organisation at rural and urban level will be strengthened, municipalities capacities in public finance management will be supported, and civil service capacity will be strengthen for better service delivery.
